prompt: In this anime style scene, a festive wedding reception unfolds with vibrant clarity. On the left stands a bride in a white lace gown, her veil cascading down her back. Next to her on the right is a groom in a sharp black tuxedo, smiling broadly. Centered between them is a multi-tiered white cake adorned with fresh roses. A woman in a blue dress sits on a velvet chair near the cake, holding a champagne flute. Beside her, a man in a red scarf leans casually against the wall, watching the couple. In the foreground, a small brown dog sits attentively on the polished floor, looking up at the guests. Behind the dog, a waiter in a crisp white uniform carries a silver tray, moving toward the table. To the far left, an elderly woman in a floral kimono points gently at the cake, sharing a moment with a young boy in a navy suit who stands next to her. The boy looks at the elderly woman with curiosity. Above them, colorful confetti floats in the air, adding to the celebration. A large crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling, casting subtle reflections on the surfaces below. There is no rain visible through the windows, and there is no band playing instruments in the background. The bride looks at the groom with affection. The groom holds the bride's hand tightly. The waiter places the tray next to the seated woman. The dog rests its head near the boy's foot. The scene captures a singular, joyful moment frozen in time, emphasizing the distinct characters and their connections within the bustling hall.
